objective_comparisons.label: Masked Reconstruction (MAE)
objective_comparisons.description: Retains rich spatial-temporal boundary signals; highest frozen probe accuracy.

objective_comparisons.label: Supervised Classification
objective_comparisons.description: Strong categorical semantic clustering; moderate adjacent frame drift.

objective_comparisons.label: Contrastive Learning (SimCLR)
objective_comparisons.description: Instance discrimination encourages view invariance, leading to higher temporal jump.

objective_comparisons.label: Random Initialization (Scratch)
objective_comparisons.description: Unstructured representations require extensive end-to-end gradient updates.

aggregator_comparisons.label: Vanilla SimpleRNN (BPTT)
aggregator_comparisons.notes: Inherently models directional temporal sequence dynamics through recurrence.

aggregator_comparisons.label: Learned Temporal Pooling
aggregator_comparisons.notes: Learns frame salience weights via softmax scoring; order-invariant set aggregation.

aggregator_comparisons.label: Mean Temporal Pooling
aggregator_comparisons.notes: Uniform average across all valid timesteps; parameter-free baseline.

aggregator_comparisons.label: Max Temporal Pooling
aggregator_comparisons.notes: Feature-wise maximum over time; captures dominant activations.

aggregator_comparisons.label: Last-Frame Baseline
aggregator_comparisons.notes: Discards temporal context; evaluates single terminal observation.

robustness_benchmarks.label: Frame Drop (50% dropped)
robustness_benchmarks.description: Removes every second frame while preserving sequence order.

robustness_benchmarks.label: Frame Stutter (Duplication)
robustness_benchmarks.description: Duplicates anchor frame simulating temporal stutter.

robustness_benchmarks.label: Frame Shuffling (Permutation)
robustness_benchmarks.description: Permutes frame order; tests RNN directional sensitivity.

robustness_benchmarks.label: Temporal Subsampling (Stride 2)
robustness_benchmarks.description: Downsamples temporal resolution across the sequence.

robustness_benchmarks.label: Spatial Gaussian Noise (σ = 0.15)
robustness_benchmarks.description: Applies pixel noise uniformly across all frames.

candidate_failures.description: Stationary control exhibited slight fluctuation due to background noise.
Key transition frame dropped leading to misclassification into top_to_bottom.
Subtle feature magnitude changes despite large horizontal spatial displacement.
